verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Fivetran publishing its own MCP server (fivetran-mcp) so external agents can call Fivetran's tools — the opposite direction of this story. There is no evidence that Fivetran itself can act as an MCP client and consume/plug in external MCP servers to use their tools; the AI coding-agent plugins (intdir-6) add Fivetran skills to third-party agents rather than letting Fivetran consume MCP tool servers.
